title: Norm coefficient projection on supported rationalized lattice generators
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p,\ell$, a separably closed field $K$ of characteristic $p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside an algebraic closure $\Omega$, and the extended norm topology on $E,\Omega$. Let $\mathcal O_E=\{x\in E:|x|\leq1\}$ with its subspace topology [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. On profinite sets put $A(P)=C(P,E)$, $O(P)=C(P,\mathcal O_E)$ and $B(P)=C(P,\Omega)$, using all continuous functions, and let $A\to B$ be inclusion [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]. For a scheme $Y$ put $R_Y=p_Y^*R$ for $R=O,A,B$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use internal module objects, ordinary unbounded derived categories and K-flat derived tensor [sk-def-sfb-module-objects, sk-def-sfb-derived-categories, sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom].

Let $T$ be separated of finite type over $K$, let $a:S\hookrightarrow T$ be a constructible locally closed immersion, and let $L_0$ be a lisse finite-rank $O_S$-module [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module]. Factor $a=i\circ j$ as an open immersion into its closure followed by the closed immersion and put $a_!=i_*j_!$ using the exact coefficient-module functors [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-open-closed-recollement]. Put $Q=A_T\otimes_{O_T}a_!L_0$, as a complex in degree zero. Let $\mathcal H_R=Rp_{T*,R}$ be the ordinary right derived direct image of module sheaves from $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$ to internal condensed $R$-modules, for $R=A,B$ [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull, sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point]. Then the specified morphism
$$\pi_Q:B\otimes_A^L\mathcal H_A(Q)\longrightarrow\mathcal H_B(B_T\otimes_{A_T}^LQ)$$
is an isomorphism in $D(\operatorname{Mod}_B)$. It is the adjoint, under derived scalar extension and restriction, of $\mathcal H_A(Q)\to\mathcal H_A(\operatorname{Res}(B_T\otimes^L_{A_T}Q))\cong\operatorname{Res}\mathcal H_B(B_T\otimes^L_{A_T}Q)$ induced by $q\mapsto1\otimes q$ on a flat-term K-flat resolution. Equivalently it is the counit-adjoint coefficient projection for $p_T$. Empty $S,T$ and $L_0=0$ are included. No completeness of $\Omega$, flatness of $A\to B$, finite-subextension-valued replacement of $B$, assertion about arbitrary constructible complexes, or arithmetic Galois-action comparison is assumed.

proof.text: A finite-type scheme over $K$ is Noetherian. The constructible locally closed $S$ and its closure are also finite type, so their opens are qc. Since $A=O[1/\ell]$ is flat, support projection gives $Q=a_!(A_S\otimes_{O_S}L_0)[0]$. Its lisse factor is locally $A_S^r$; supported-lisse constructibility makes $Q$ bounded constructible.

proof.text: Write $T_Z=B_Z\otimes^L_{A_Z}-$ and $\beta_f$ for its counit-adjoint direct-image mate. Every scheme $Z$ used below is Noetherian by step 1, so [lem-sfb-continuous-algcl-scalar-extension-constructible] applies: $T_Z$ takes every bounded constructible $A_Z$-complex to a bounded constructible $B_Z$-complex of finite Tor amplitude. For $Z=T$ and $Q=a_!L[0]$ of step 1 it gives $T_TQ\cong a_!(B_S\otimes_{A_S}L)[0]$, locally $a_!B_S^r[0]$. No flatness of $A\to B$ is used.

proof.text: For proper $f:X\to Y$ between separated finite-type $K$-schemes and bounded constructible $C$, finite-$E$ proper finiteness makes $M=Rf_{*,A}C$ bounded constructible. Continuous-algebraic-closure proper finiteness makes each $H^q(Rf_{*,B}T_XC)$ constructible. To use its chosen closure, take an algebraic-closure isomorphism; norm uniqueness on every finite subfield makes it isometric. Its coefficient equivalence preserves finite Tor, constructibility and direct images by the ring-change comparison. Since $\Omega/E$ has countable dimension, the new countable projection criterion applies to $M,T_YM$ and this target. The new endomorphism-corner normalization identifies its arrow with $\beta_f$, without coefficient flatness.

proof.text:
For a qc open $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ between separated finite-type $K$-schemes, its $\beta_j$-isomorphism locus is thick. A tame-pair generator is $G=Rq_*H$, $H=b_!L[0]$. Supported-lisse and rational-open constructibility make $H,Rj'_*H$ bounded constructible. Step 3 gives $\beta_q,\beta_p$; tame-boundary comparison gives $\beta_{j',H}$. Normalized composition for $jq=pj'$ gives
$Rj_{*,B}(\beta_{q,H})\circ\beta_{j,G}=Rp_{*,B}(\beta_{j',H})\circ\beta_{p,Rj'_{*,A}H}$.
Cancel the invertible $Rj_{*,B}(\beta_{q,H})$; finite thick generation finishes.

proof.text: Nagata over the qcqs base $\operatorname{Spec}K$ compactifies $t:T\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ as $pj$. The proper compactification is finite type and Noetherian, so $j$ is qc. Rational open constructibility makes $Rj_*Q$ bounded constructible. Steps 3--4 and normalized scalar-mate composition give the specified invertible $\beta_{t,Q}$.

proof.text: Field/action section transport for separably closed $K$ has trivial Galois group and identifies $\beta_{t,Q}$ with the specified $\pi_Q$, preserving the scalar unit $q\mapsto1\otimes q$. Empty schemes and zero lattice give $Q=0$, hence the unique zero-object isomorphism.
